item_short_desc: Rothco's Stainless Steel Shoe Horn is the perfect tool for anyone needing assistance with putting on tight-fitting footwear. Made from 100% high-quality stainless steel, this shoe horn is built to last, offering durability and strength for everyday use. The added length of 16.5 inches allows you to slip into your shoes without bending or straining, making it ideal for boots, dress shoes, and any snug footwear. The hooked end provides a secure grip, ensuring stability as you guide your foot in.
